choose_language_hint: 您可以随时从顶部更改。
travellers_hint: 请为每位乘机人添加机票、护照和签证。照片或PDF文件都可以。
reading: 正在看文件…这可能需要一分钟。
err_files: 请添加所有三份文件：机票、护照和签证。
err_network: 无法连接到服务器。请检查您的网络并重试。
ready_body: 您的所有文件都准备好了，可以开始这次旅行。
fix_title: 飞行前请处理好这些问题
fix_body: 有些事情需要您注意。它们也已添加到您的清单中。
checklist_saved: 您的勾选已保存到此手机和网上。
start_over_confirm: 要开始新的旅程吗？此旅程将从手机中删除。
contacts_hint: 如果您需要帮助，工作人员应该联系谁？这些号码会显示在您的“我迷路了”卡片上。
contact_phone: 带国家代码的电话号码
err_contacts: 请至少添加一个联系人，包括姓名和电话号码，例如 +91 98400 12345。
ai_badge: AI建议 · 请在官方网站上确认
arrived: 您已到达。祝您旅途愉快！
lost_line: 我第一次坐飞机，请帮帮我。
help_val: 问讯处或任何穿制服的工作人员
ask_hint: 点击麦克风，用您的语言提问，或在下面输入。
listening: 正在听…再按一下就停止
mic_denied: 麦克风没开。您可以打字。
staff_hint: 说出或打出您想告诉工作人员的话。我们会用大大的英文字母显示出来。
pass_hint: 拍下您的登机牌。我们会解释每个部分，并帮您记住登机口和登机时间。
pass_saved: 登机口和登机时间已保存。
assist_hint: 您可以请机场工作人员帮忙，从入口一直到飞机上。这是免费的。
sent_desk: 已发送到机场协助柜台。
saved_desk: 请求已保存。请向航空公司工作人员出示此号码。
no_contacts: 还没有家人电话。请在“联系人”中添加。
no_voice: 此手机无法朗读。请出示卡片。
err_auth_email_in_use: 这个邮箱已经注册过了。请直接登录。
err_auth_invalid: 邮箱或密码不对，请再试一次。
err_auth_weak_password: 密码太简单了。请用至少6个字符的密码。
err_auth_too_many: 尝试次数太多了。请稍后再试。
err_auth_default: 登录失败了。请再试一次。
auth_pass_upper: 密码里至少要有一个大写字母。
auth_pass_lower: 密码里至少要有一个小写字母。
auth_pass_num: 密码里至少要有一个数字。
auth_pass_sym: 密码里至少要有一个特殊符号。
auth_verify_email_sent: 我们已经把验证链接发到您的邮箱了。请去邮箱里点一下链接来登录。
auth_email_not_verified: 您的邮箱还没有验证。请去邮箱里找一下验证链接。
auth_otp_sent: 验证码已发送到您的手机。
auth_phone_desc: 请输入您的手机号码。如果您还没有账号，我们会自动帮您创建一个。
docs_found_title: 您的证件已经保存好啦
docs_found_hint: 我们找到了您之前上传的机票、护照和签证。您可以继续用这些，或者换掉不对的或已经改了的。
logout_confirm: 要退出吗？您的行程会保留。再次登录即可查看。
quick_hint: 如果已经办好了，我们就会把它从您的清单中删除。您可以随时在这里更改您的答案。
dup_body: 这些文件已经在您的一个行程中了。要不打开那个行程，这样所有东西都在一个地方？
help_intro: 您的文件都准备好了。如果您在任何时候需要帮助，请点击屏幕底部的蓝色“帮助”按钮。如果您迷路了，请点击红色的“我迷路了”按钮。
bag_not_on_ticket: 您的机票上没有打印：这是通常的限制。请和航空公司确认一下。
help_hint_short: 需要帮忙吗？请点击屏幕底部的蓝色“帮助”按钮，或者红色的“我迷路了”按钮。点击这里可以听到这段话。
boarding_estimated: 预计：起飞前45分钟左右。请您根据登机牌上的时间，点击保存。
wt_hint: 一分钟带您了解这个软件怎么用，会用您的行程来演示。
wt_lang_say: 首先，请选择您的语言。所有屏幕显示和语音都会随之改变。
wt_upload_say: 请为每位乘机人拍下机票、护照和签证的照片。应用会自动读取这些信息。
wt_check_say: 应用会检查姓名、日期和护照有效期，并告诉您是否有需要修改的地方。
wt_contacts_say: 添加家人的电话号码，这样在您需要帮助时，可以一键呼叫他们。
wt_checklist_say: 乘机前您的待办事项清单。完成一项就勾选一项。
wt_day_say: 在机场，请一步一步跟着指示走。需要时，可以把英文句子给工作人员看。
wt_help_say: 点击“帮助”，您可以通过语音或文字提问，向工作人员展示句子，或者了解您的登机牌。
wt_lost_say: 点击“我迷路了”，可以向工作人员展示一张大卡片，上面有您的航班、登机口和家人电话号码。
wt_end_say: 这就是“我的首次飞行”应用。祝您旅途平安！
auth_voice: 要登录，请您输入带国家区号的电话号码，然后点击 {send}。我们会通过短信给您发送一个验证码。或者，您也可以点击 {google}。
auth_voice_otp: 我们已经通过短信给您的手机发送了一个验证码。请您输入验证码，然后点击 {verify}。
fb_hint: 您的意见能帮助我们把这个软件做得更好，让更多第一次坐飞机的人受益。
fb_helped: 哪个地方对您帮助最大？
fb_comment: 还有其他想说的吗？(可不填)
fb_comment_ph: 哪些地方您觉得容易？哪些地方觉得难？
fb_thanks: 谢谢您！您的意见已保存。
lang_voice_hint: 点麦克风，然后说出您的语言，比如“泰米尔语”或“印地语”。
lang_voice_fail: 抱歉，我没听清您说的语言。请再试一次，或者在下面选择您的语言。
lang_mic_denied: 麦克风未授权。请在下面选择您的语言。

__source.choose_language_hint: You can change it any time from the top.
__source.travellers_hint: For each person, add their ticket, passport and visa. A photo or PDF is fine.
__source.reading: Reading the documents… this can take up to a minute.
__source.err_files: Add all three: ticket, passport and visa.
__source.err_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
__source.ready_body: All documents look good for this trip.
__source.fix_body: Some things need attention. They are also added to your checklist.
__source.checklist_saved: Your ticks are saved on this phone and online.
__source.start_over_confirm: Start a new trip? This trip will be removed from this phone.
__source.no_trips_yet: You don't have any trips yet.
__source.auth_have_acct: Already have an account? Sign In
__source.contacts_hint: Who should staff call if you need help? These numbers appear on your I'm Lost card.
__source.err_contacts: Add at least one contact with a name and a phone number like +91 98400 12345.
__source.ai_badge: AI suggestion · confirm on the official website
__source.tap_big: Tap to show in big letters
__source.arrived: You have arrived. Have a good trip!
__source.lost_line: I am travelling for the first time. Please help me.
__source.help_val: Information desk or any staff in uniform
__source.ask_hint: Tap the mic and ask in your language, or type below.
__source.mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. You can type instead.
__source.staff_hint: Say or type what you want to tell staff. We show it in big English letters.
__source.pass_hint: Take a photo of your boarding pass. We explain every part and save your gate and boarding time.
__source.assist_hint: Ask the airport to help you from the entrance to the plane. It is free.
__source.sent_desk: Sent to the airport assist desk.
__source.saved_desk: Request saved. Show this number to airline staff.
__source.no_contacts: No family number yet. Add one in Contacts.
__source.no_voice: This phone cannot read aloud. Show the card instead.
__source.err_auth_email_in_use: This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.
__source.err_auth_invalid: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
__source.err_auth_weak_password: Password is too weak. Please use at least 6 characters.
__source.err_auth_too_many: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
__source.auth_pass_len: Password must be at least 12 characters.
__source.auth_pass_upper: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
__source.auth_pass_lower: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
__source.auth_pass_num: Password must contain at least one number.
__source.auth_pass_sym: Password must contain at least one symbol.
__source.auth_verify_email_sent: A verification link has been sent to your email. Please verify your email to sign in.
__source.auth_email_not_verified: Your email is not verified. Please check your inbox for the verification link.
__source.auth_phone_desc: Enter your phone number. If you don't have an account, one will be created for you automatically.
__source.docs_found_hint: We found the ticket, passport and visa you uploaded before. Continue with them, or replace any that are wrong or changed.
__source.logout_confirm: Log out? Your trips stay saved. Log in again to see them.
__source.quick_hint: If it is already done, we leave it out of your checklist. You can change your answer here any time.
__source.dup_body: These documents are already in one of your trips. Open that trip instead, so everything stays in one place?
__source.help_intro: Your documents are ready. If you need help at any time, tap the blue Help button at the bottom of the screen. If you are lost, tap the red I'm Lost button.
__source.bag_not_on_ticket: Not printed on your ticket: this is the usual limit. Please confirm with the airline.
__source.help_hint_short: Need help? Use the blue Help button or the red I'm Lost button at the bottom of the screen. Tap here to hear this.
__source.boarding_estimated: Estimated: about 45 minutes before departure. Change it to the time on your boarding pass and tap Save.
__source.wt_hint: A 1-minute tour of how this app works, shown with your own trip.
__source.wt_lang_say: First, pick your language. Every screen and every voice switches to it.
__source.wt_upload_say: Add each traveller with a photo of the ticket, passport and visa. The app reads them for you.
__source.wt_check_say: The app checks names, dates and passport validity, and tells you if anything needs fixing.
__source.wt_contacts_say: Add family numbers, so you can call them with one tap if you need help.
__source.wt_checklist_say: Your to-do list before the flight. Tick each task when it is done.
__source.wt_day_say: At the airport, follow one step at a time. Show the English sentence to staff when you need to.
__source.wt_help_say: Tap Help to ask any question by voice or text, show a sentence to staff, or understand your boarding pass.
__source.wt_lost_say: Tap I'm Lost to show staff a big card with your flight, gate and family numbers.
__source.wt_end_say: That is MyFirstFlight. Have a safe trip!
__source.auth_voice: To sign in, type your phone number with the country code, then tap {send}. We will send you a code by SMS. Or tap {google}.
__source.auth_voice_otp: We sent a code to your phone by SMS. Type the code, then tap {verify}.
__source.fb_title: How was your trip with MyFirstFlight?
__source.fb_hint: Your answer helps us make the app better for other first-time flyers.
__source.fb_comment_ph: What was easy? What was hard?
__source.fb_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback is saved.
__source.lang_voice_hint: Tap the mic and say it, for example "Tamil" or "हिंदी".
__source.lang_voice_fail: Sorry, I could not hear a language. Please try again, or tap your language below.
__source.lang_mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. Please tap your language below.
